calculation.description: Ranks assets by their 40-session beta to the equal-weight return of the 15 tradable benchmark instruments. Higher beta receives a higher score. The signal is lagged one completed session before forward-return evaluation to prevent lookahead.

validation.regime_notes: Positive beta score is equivalent to the negative-beta resilience experiment and reverses its negative IC. Annual 10d IC was positive in 6 of 7 calendar periods; 2022 was negative. Small cross-section requires conservative uncertainty interpretation.

signal_provenance.artifact: computed directly from persistent/stock_data close series; no future data beyond 2026-07-15
signal_provenance.method: Spearman cross-sectional IC; dates require at least 8 valid instruments
